domain_definition: Points at least 0.8 nm from every non-water heavy atom, including ions; minimum-image periodic Euclidean distances. Water counted using its oxygen in the same domain.

statistics.interpretation: One frame. Monte Carlo errors describe geometric volume integration only, not MD sampling or thermodynamic uncertainty. Low-water-proximity regions are geometric diagnostics, not identified vapor phases.

limitations: Not a calibrated liquid-density or surface-validation test.
Single frame may include cavities and strong spatial heterogeneity; this is not necessarily thermodynamic bulk water.
No adsorption, phase or retention inference.
Whole-mixture density includes protein, PE and ions and must not be compared directly with pure-water density.
